AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.

3. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

5. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

6. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.

7. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

9. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.

10. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

11. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Stability and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
